pairs: Verbum quod locutus est Dominus de Babylone et de terra Chaldæorum,
The word that the Lord has spoken about Babylon and about the land of the Chaldeans,
by the hand of Jeremiah the prophet.
Their graven things have been confounded.
Quoniam ascendit contra eam gens ab aquilone,
For a nation has ascended against her from the north,
quæ ponet terram ejus in solitudinem,
which will set her land in desolation.
et non erit qui habitet in ea ab homine usque ad pecus:
And there will be no one who may live within it,
For they have been removed and have gone away.
In diebus illis, et in tempore illo,
In those days and in that time, says the Lord,
ait Dominus, venient filii Israël ipsi et filii Juda simul:
the sons of Israel will advance, they and the sons of Judah together.
Weeping as they walk, they will hurry on,
and they will seek the Lord their God.
They will ask the way to Zion;
their faces will be set toward this place.
et apponentur ad Dominum fœdere sempiterno,
and will be joined to the Lord by an everlasting covenant,
which nothing will wipe away into oblivion.
Grex perditus factus est populus meus:
My people have become a lost flock.
Their shepherds have led them astray
and have caused them to wander in the mountains.
They have crossed from mountain to hill.
They have forgotten their resting place.
All whom they have found, they have devoured.
pro eo quod peccaverunt Domino decori justitiæ,
For it is they who have sinned against the Lord, the beauty of justice,
and against the Lord, the hope of their fathers.’
Withdraw from the midst of Babylon,
and go forth from the land of the Chaldeans.
et estote quasi hædi ante gregem.
And be like young goats before the flock.
For behold, I am raising up,
et adducam in Babylonem congregationem gentium magnarum de terra aquilonis,
and I will lead against Babylon, a congregation of great nations from the land of the north.
And they will be prepared against her,
and from there she will be taken.
sagitta ejus quasi viri fortis interfectoris:
Their arrows, like those of a strong man, a killer,
And Chaldea will become a prey.
All who lay waste to her will be filled,
quoniam effusi estis sicut vituli super herbam,
For you have spread out like calves upon the grass,
and you have bellowed like bulls.
Your mother has been exceedingly shamed,
and she who bore you has become equal to the dust.
she will be the last among the nations,
By the wrath of the Lord, it will not be inhabited.
Instead, it will be entirely desolate.
omnis qui transibit per Babylonem stupebit, et sibilabit super universis plagis ejus.
Everyone who passes by Babylon will be stupefied and will hiss over all her wounds.
Prepare yourselves against Babylon, on every side,
all you who bend the bow.
You should not spare the arrows,
for she has sinned against the Lord.
For where she has put forth a hand,
For it is the vengeance of the Lord.
et tenentem falcem in tempore messis:
and the one who holds the sickle in the time of harvest.
a facie gladii columbæ unusquisque ad populum suum convertetur,
Before the face of the sword of the dove, each one will turn back to his people,
et singuli ad terram suam fugient.
and every one will flee to his own land.
The lions have driven him away.
First, the king of Assyria devoured him. And last,
iste novissimus exossavit eum Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis.
this Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, has taken away his bones.
Because of this, thus says the Lord of hosts,
Ecce ego visitabo regem Babylonis et terram ejus,
Behold, I will visit the king of Babylon and his land,
just as I have visited the king of Assyria.
et reducam Israël ad habitaculum suum:
And I will lead back Israel to his habitation.
And he will pasture on Carmel and Bashan,
et in monte Ephraim et Galaad saturabitur anima ejus.
and his soul will be satiated at mount Ephraim and Gilead.
In those days and at that time,
the iniquity of Israel will be sought,
And the sin of Judah will be sought,
For I will be forgiving to them,
quoniam propitius ero eis quos reliquero.
Ascend against the land of the rulers,
et interfice quæ post eos sunt,
and destroy whatever has been left behind them,
et fac juxta omnia quæ præcepi tibi.
and act according to all that I have instructed you.
A voice of war in the land,
Quomodo confractus est et contritus malleus universæ terræ?
How has the mallet of the entire earth been broken and crushed?
quomodo versa est in desertum Babylon in gentibus?
How has Babylon been turned into a desert among the nations?
and you did not realize it.
You have been discovered and seized,
Aperuit Dominus thesaurum suum, et protulit vasa iræ suæ,
The Lord has opened his storehouse, and he has brought forth the instruments of his wrath.
quoniam opus est Domino Deo exercituum,
For there is work for the Lord, the God of hosts,
within the land of the Chaldeans.
Venite ad eam ab extremis finibus;
Advance against her from the furthest regions!
aperite ut exeant qui conculcent eam:
Open, so that those who will trample her may go out!
et interficite eam, nec sit quidquam reliquum.
and destroy her. And let there be nothing left of her.
Let them descend to the slaughter.
It is the voice of those who are fleeing
et eorum qui evaserunt de terra Babylonis,
and of those who have escaped from the land of Babylon:
ut annuntient in Sion ultionem Domini Dei nostri,
to announce in Zion the revenge of the Lord our God,
Announce it to the many in Babylon,
to all who bend the bow.
Stand together against her all around,
Repay her according to her work.
In accord with all that she has done,
For she has raised herself up against the Lord,
against the Holy One of Israel.
Idcirco cadent juvenes ejus in plateis ejus,
For this reason, her young men will fall in her streets.
et omnes viri bellatores ejus conticescent in die illa,
And all her men of war will be silenced, in that day,
says the Lord, the God of hosts.
And the proud one will fall
et non erit qui suscitet eum:
And there will be no one who may lift him up.
et succendam ignem in urbibus ejus,
And I will kindle a fire in his cities,
et devorabit omnia in circuitu ejus.
and it will devour everything around him.”
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
Calumniam sustinent filii Israël, et filii Juda simul:
“The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have endured calumny together.
omnes qui ceperunt eos, tenent: nolunt dimittere eos.
All who have seized them are holding them and refusing to release them.
The Lord of hosts is his name.
He will defend their case in judgment,
so that he may terrify the land
and disturb the inhabitants of Babylon.
A sword is for the Chaldeans,
and for the inhabitants of Babylon,
A sword is for her diviners,
A sword is for her strong ones,
A sword is for their horses,
et ad omne vulgus quod est in medio ejus:
and for all the common people who are in her midst.
And they will be like women.
A sword is for her storehouses,
A drought is over her waters,
and they will be dried up.
For it is a land of graven images,
Propterea habitabunt dracones cum faunis ficariis,
Because of this, dragons will live there with the fig fauns,
and ostriches will live in it.
et non inhabitabitur ultra usque in sempiternum,
And it will no longer be inhabited, even in perpetuity,
nec exstruetur usque ad generationem et generationem.
nor will it be raised up, even from generation to generation.
Sicut subvertit Dominus Sodomam et Gomorrham,
Just as the Lord overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah,
et non incolet eam filius hominis.
and a son of man will not tend it.
Behold, a people arrives from the north,
et reges multi consurgent a finibus terræ.
And many kings will rise up from the ends of the earth.
They will take up the bow and the shield.
and they will ride upon horses,
sicut vir paratus ad prælium contra te,
like a man prepared for battle against you,
The king of Babylon has heard the report about them,
and his hands have been weakened.
like the pains of a woman giving birth.
Ecce quasi leo ascendet, de superbia Jordanis ad pulchritudinem robustam,
Behold, he will ascend like a lion from the arrogance of the Jordan to the robust beauty.
quia subito currere faciam eum ad illam.
For I will cause him to rush upon her suddenly.
And who will be the elect one,
quem præponam ei? quis est enim similis mei?
whom I may appoint over her? For who is like me?
et quis est iste pastor, qui resistat vultui meo?
And who is that pastor who can withstand my countenance?”
Propterea audite consilium Domini quod mente concepit adversum Babylonem,
Because of this, listen to the counsel of the Lord, which he has conceived in his mind against Babylon,
et cogitationes ejus quas cogitavit super terram Chaldæorum:
and to his thoughts, which he has devised against the land of the Chaldeans:
“Certainly the little ones of the flocks will pull them down,
nisi dissipatum fuerit cum ipsis habitaculum eorum.
unless their habitation will have been destroyed with them.
A voce captivitatis Babylonis commota est terra,
At the voice of the captivity of Babylon, the earth has been moved,
et clamor inter gentes auditus est.
and an outcry has been heard among the nations.”
